name: CallElimCorrect.substOldPostSubset
proof:
open OldExpressions in
theorem substOldPostSubset:
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression)
    (substOld h2 (Lambda.LExpr.fvar m h1 ty) post)).Subset
    (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression) post ++ [h1])
 := by
  have aux : ∀ {a b A B}, a ⊆ A ++ [h1] → b ⊆ B ++ [h1] → a ++ b ⊆ (A ++ B) ++ [h1] := by grind
  induction post with
  | abs _ _ _ => assumption
  | quant _ _ _ _ _ | eq _ _ _ => apply aux <;> assumption
  | ite _ _ _ _ ih₁ ih₂ ih₃ => apply aux (aux ih₁ ih₂) ih₃
  | app _ _ _ =>
      unfold substOld
      split
      · split
        · apply List.subset_append_right
        · apply List.subset_append_left
      · apply aux <;> assumption
  | _ => apply List.subset_append_left

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius
proof:
theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  unfold fiberwiseClose at h_fw_dist_lt
  unfold hammingClose
  -- 2 * Δ₀(f, ↑(BBF_Code 𝔽q β ⟨↑i, ⋯⟩)) < ↑(BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨↑i, ⋯⟩)
  let d_fw := fiberwiseDistance 𝔽q β (i := i) steps h_i_add_steps f
  let C_i := (BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  let d_H := Code.distFromCode f C_i
  let d_i := BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 (⟨i, by omega⟩)
  let d_i_plus_steps := BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i.val + steps, by omega⟩

  have h_d_i_gt_0 : d_i > 0 := by
    dsimp only [BBF_CodeDistance, d_i] -- ⊢ 2 ^ (ℓ + 𝓡 - ↑i) - 2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i) + 1 > 0
    
    
    omega

  have h_C_i_nonempty : Nonempty C_i := by
    simp only [nonempty_subtype]
    exact Submodule.nonempty (BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i.val, by omega⟩)

  -- 1. Relate Hamming distance `d_H` to fiber-wise distance `d_fw`.
  obtain ⟨g', h_g'_mem, h_g'_min_card⟩ : ∃ g' ∈ C_i, d_fw
    = (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g').ncard := by
    -- Let `S` be the set of all possible fiber-wise disagreement sizes.
    let S := (fun (g : C_i) => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps
      f g).ncard) '' Set.univ
    -- The code `C_i` (a submodule) is non-empty, so `S` is also non-empty.
    have hS_nonempty : S.Nonempty := by
      refine Set.image_nonempty.mpr ?_

      exact Set.univ_nonempty
    -- For a non-empty set of natural numbers, `sInf` is an element of the set.
    have h_sInf_mem : sInf S ∈ S := Nat.sInf_mem hS_nonempty
    -- By definition, `d_fw = sInf S`.
    
    -- Since `sInf S` is in the image set `S`, there must be an element `g_subtype` in the domain
    -- (`C_i`) that maps to it. This `g_subtype` is the codeword we're looking for.
    
    rcases h_sInf_mem with ⟨g_subtype, _, h_eq⟩
    -- Extract the codeword and its membership proof.
    exact ⟨g_subtype.val, g_subtype.property, by exact id (Eq.symm h_eq)⟩

  -- The Hamming distance to any codeword `g'` is bounded by `d_fw * 2 ^ steps`.
  have h_dist_le_fw_dist_times_fiber_size : (hammingDist f g' : ℕ∞) ≤ d_fw * 2 ^ steps := by
    -- This proves `dist f g' ≤ (fiberwiseDisagreementSet ... f g').ncard * 2 ^ steps`
    -- and lifts to ℕ∞. We prove the `Nat` version `hammingDist f g' ≤ ...`,
    -- which is equivalent.
    change (Δ₀(f, g') : ℕ∞) ≤ ↑d_fw * ((2 ^ steps : ℕ) : ℕ∞)
    rw [←ENat.coe_mul, ENat.coe_le_coe, h_g'_min_card]
    -- Let ΔH be the finset of actually bad x points where f and g' disagree.
    set ΔH := Finset.filter (fun x => f x ≠ g' x) Finset.univ
    
    
    -- Y_bad is the set of quotient points y that THERE EXISTS a bad fiber point x
    set Y_bad := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g'
    simp only at * -- simplify domain indices everywhere

    -- ⊢ #ΔH ≤ Y_bad.ncard * 2 ^ steps

    have hFinType_Y_bad : Fintype Y_bad := by exact Fintype.ofFinite ↑Y_bad
    -- Every point of disagreement `x` must belong to a fiber over some `y` in `Y_bad`,
    -- BY DEFINITION of `Y_bad`. Therefore, `ΔH` is a subset of the union of the fibers
    -- of `Y_bad`
    have h_ΔH_subset_bad_fiber_points : ΔH ⊆ Finset.biUnion Y_bad.toFinset
        (t := fun y => ((qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
          (h_i_add_steps := by apply Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right_of_le; omega) (y := y)) ''
          (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin ((2:ℕ)^steps)))).toFinset) := by
      -- ⊢ If any x ∈ ΔH, then x ∈ Union(qMap_total_fiber(y), ∀ y ∈ Y_bad)
      intro x hx_in_ΔH; -- ⊢ x ∈ Union(qMap_total_fiber(y), ∀ y ∈ Y_bad)
      simp only [mem_filter, ΔH] at hx_in_ΔH
      -- Now we actually apply iterated qMap into x to get y_of_x,
      -- then x ∈ qMap_total_fiber(y_of_x) by definition
      let y_of_x := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps x
      apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr; use y_of_x
      -- ⊢ y_of_x ∈ Y_bad.toFinset ∧ x ∈ qMap_total_fiber(y_of_x)
      have h_elemenet_Y_bad : y_of_x ∈ Y_bad.toFinset := by
        -- ⊢ y ∈ Y_bad.toFinset
        simp only [fiberwiseDisagreementSet, iteratedQuotientMap, ne_eq, Subtype.exists, Set.toFinset_setOf,
    mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, Y_bad]
        -- one bad fiber point of y_of_x is x itself
        let X := x.val
        have h_X_in_source : X ∈ sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) := by
          exact Submodule.coe_mem x
        use X
        use h_X_in_source
        -- ⊢ Ŵ_steps⁽ⁱ⁾(X) = y (iterated quotient map) ∧ ¬f ⟨X, ⋯⟩ = g' ⟨X, ⋯⟩
        have h_forward_iterated_qmap : Polynomial.eval X
            (intermediateNormVpoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨↑i, by omega⟩
              ⟨steps, by simp only; omega⟩) = y_of_x := by
          rfl;
        have h_eval_diff : f ⟨X, by omega⟩ ≠ g' ⟨X, by omega⟩ := by
          unfold X
          simp only [Subtype.coe_eta, ne_eq, hx_in_ΔH, not_false_eq_true]
        simp only [h_forward_iterated_qmap, Subtype.coe_eta, h_eval_diff, not_false_eq_true, and_self]
      simp only [h_elemenet_Y_bad]

      set qMapFiber := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
        (h_i_add_steps := by apply Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right_of_le; omega) (y := y_of_x)
      simp only [coe_univ, Set.image_univ, Set.toFinset_range, mem_image, mem_univ, true_and]
      use (pointToIterateQuotientIndex (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
        (h_i_add_steps := by omega) (x := x))
      exact is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps (by omega)
        (x := x) (y := y_of_x).mp (by rfl)
    -- ⊢ #ΔH ≤ Y_bad.ncard * 2 ^ steps
    -- The cardinality of a subset is at most the cardinality of the superset.
    apply (Finset.card_le_card h_ΔH_subset_bad_fiber_points).trans
    -- The cardinality of a disjoint union is the sum of cardinalities.
    rw [Finset.card_biUnion]
    · -- The size of the sum is the number of bad fibers (`Y_bad.ncard`) times
      -- the size of each fiber (`2 ^ steps`).
      simp only [Set.toFinset_card]
      have h_card_fiber_per_quotient_point := card_qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β
        (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) i steps h_i_add_steps
      simp only [Set.image_univ, Fintype.card_ofFinset, Subtype.forall] at h_card_fiber_per_quotient_point
      have h_card_fiber_of_each_y : ∀ y ∈ Y_bad.toFinset,
          Fintype.card ((qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨↑i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
            (h_i_add_steps := by apply Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right_of_le; omega) (y := y)) ''
            ↑(Finset.univ : Finset (Fin ((2:ℕ)^steps)))) = 2 ^ steps := by
        intro y hy_in_Y_bad
        have hy_card_fiber_of_y := h_card_fiber_per_quotient_point (a := y) (b := by
          exact Submodule.coe_mem y)
        simp only [coe_univ, Set.image_univ, Fintype.card_ofFinset, hy_card_fiber_of_y]
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl h_card_fiber_of_each_y]
      -- ⊢ ∑ x ∈ Y_bad.toFinset, 2 ^ steps ≤ Y_bad.encard.toNat * 2 ^ steps
      simp only [sum_const, Set.toFinset_card, smul_eq_mul, ge_iff_le]
      conv_rhs => rw [←_root_.Nat.card_coe_set_eq] -- convert .ncard back to .card
      -- ⊢ Fintype.card ↑Y_bad ≤ Nat.card ↑Y_bad
      simp only [card_eq_fintype_card, le_refl]
    · -- Prove that the fibers for distinct quotient points y₁, y₂ are disjoint.
      intro y₁ hy₁ y₂ hy₂ hy_ne
      have h_disjoint := qMap_total_fiber_disjoint (i := ⟨↑i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
        (h_i_add_steps := by omega) (y₁ := y₁) (y₂ := y₂) (hy_ne := hy_ne)
      simp only [ coe_univ]
      exact h_disjoint

  -- The minimum distance `d_H` is bounded by the distance to this specific `g'`.
  have h_dist_bridge : d_H ≤ d_fw * 2 ^ steps := by
    -- exact h_dist_le_fw_dist_times_fiber_size
    apply le_trans (a := d_H) (c := d_fw * 2 ^ steps) (b := hammingDist f g')
    · -- ⊢ d_H ≤ ↑Δ₀(f, g')
      simp only [distFromCode, SetLike.mem_coe, hammingDist, ne_eq, d_H];
      -- ⊢ Δ₀(f, C_i) ≤ ↑Δ₀(f, g')
      -- ⊢ sInf {d | ∃ v ∈ C_i, ↑(#{i | f i ≠ v i}) ≤ d} ≤ ↑(#{i | f i ≠ g' i})
      apply sInf_le
      use g'
    · exact h_dist_le_fw_dist_times_fiber_size

  -- 2. Use the premise : `2 * d_fw < d_{i+steps}`.
  -- As a `Nat` inequality, this is equivalent to `2 * d_fw ≤ d_{i+steps} - 1`.
  have h_fw_bound : 2 * d_fw ≤ d_i_plus_steps - 1 := by
    -- Convert the ENat inequality to a Nat inequality using `a < b ↔ a + 1 ≤ b`.
    exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt)

  -- 3. The Algebraic Identity.
  -- The core of the proof is the identity : `(d_{i+steps} - 1) * 2 ^ steps = d_i - 1`.
  have h_algebraic_identity : (d_i_plus_steps - 1) * 2 ^ steps = d_i - 1 := by
    dsimp only [BBF_CodeDistance, Nat.add_one_sub_one, d_i_plus_steps, d_i]
    rw [Nat.sub_mul, ←Nat.pow_add, ←Nat.pow_add];
    have h1 : ℓ + 𝓡 - (↑i + steps) + steps = ℓ + 𝓡 - i := by
      rw [Nat.sub_add_eq_sub_sub_rev (h1 := by omega) (h2 := by omega),
        Nat.add_sub_cancel (n := i) (m := steps)]
    have h2 : (ℓ - (↑i + steps) + steps) = ℓ - i := by
      rw [Nat.sub_add_eq_sub_sub_rev (h1 := by omega) (h2 := by omega),
        Nat.add_sub_cancel (n := i) (m := steps)]
    rw [h1, h2]

  -- 4. Conclusion : Chain the inequalities to prove `2 * d_H < d_i`.
  -- We know `d_H` is finite, since `C_i` is nonempty.
  have h_dH_ne_top : d_H ≠ ⊤ := by
    simp only [ne_eq, d_H]
    rw [Code.distFromCode_eq_top_iff_empty f C_i]
    exact Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty'.mp h_C_i_nonempty

  -- We can now work with the `Nat` value of `d_H`.
  let d_H_nat := ENat.toNat d_H
  have h_dH_eq : d_H = d_H_nat := (ENat.coe_toNat h_dH_ne_top).symm

  -- The calculation is now done entirely in `Nat`.
  have h_final_inequality : 2 * d_H_nat ≤ d_i - 1 := by
    have h_bridge_nat : d_H_nat ≤ d_fw * 2 ^ steps := by
        rw [←ENat.coe_le_coe]
        exact le_of_eq_of_le (id (Eq.symm h_dH_eq)) h_dist_bridge
    calc 2 * d_H_nat
      _ ≤ 2 * (d_fw * 2 ^ steps) := by gcongr
      _ = (2 * d_fw) * 2 ^ steps := by rw [mul_assoc]
      _ ≤ (d_i_plus_steps - 1) * 2 ^ steps := by gcongr;
      _ = d_i - 1 := h_algebraic_identity

  simp only [d_H, d_H_nat] at h_dH_eq
  -- This final line is equivalent to the goal statement.
  rw [h_dH_eq]
  -- ⊢ 2 * ↑Δ₀(f, C_i).toNat < ↑(BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨↑i, ⋯⟩)
  change ((2 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) * ↑Δ₀(f, C_i).toNat < ↑(BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨↑i, by omega⟩)
  rw [←ENat.coe_mul, ENat.coe_lt_coe]
  apply Nat.lt_of_le_pred (n := 2 * Δ₀(f, C_i).toNat) (m := d_i) (h := h_d_i_gt_0)
    (h_final_inequality)

name: Electromagnetism.ElectromagneticPotential.time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema
proof:
lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hc : 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) = 𝓕.c ^ 2 := by rw [mul_comm, ← FreeSpace.c_sq]
  have hc2 : 1 / 𝓕.ε₀ = 𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ := by
    rw [FreeSpace.c_sq, div_mul_eq_mul_div, mul_div_mul_right _ _ 𝓕.μ₀_ne_zero]
  have hA1 : ∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i) = fun s =>
      1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s · (j, i)) x -
        1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * J.currentDensity 𝓕.c s x i :=
    funext fun s => (Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time
        (hA.of_le ENat.LEInfty.out) x) s).trans
      (time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h s x i)
  have hBt : ∀ j, Differentiable ℝ (fun s => ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s · (j, i)) x) :=
    fun j => Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j)
      (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff _ (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) (j, i)) x
  have hJt : Differentiable ℝ (fun s => J.currentDensity 𝓕.c s x i) :=
    LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time
      (hJ.differentiable (by decide)) x i
  have hEs : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun y => A.electricField 𝓕.c t y j) :=
    fun j => electricField_apply_contDiff_space (i := j) (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) t
  have hEd : ∀ j k, Differentiable ℝ (∂[k] (fun y => A.electricField 𝓕.c t y j)) :=
    fun j k => Space.deriv_differentiable (hEs j) k
  have hg : ∇ ⬝ A.electricField 𝓕.c t = 𝓕.ε₀⁻¹ • J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t :=
    funext fun y => ((isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ).1 h t y).1.trans
      (div_eq_inv_mul _ _)
  have lin {F G : Time → ℝ} (a b : ℝ) (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ F t) (hG : DifferentiableAt ℝ G t) :
      Time.deriv (fun s => a * F s - b * G s) t = a * Time.deriv F t - b * Time.deriv G t :=
    congrArg (fun L : Time →L[ℝ] ℝ => L 1)
      ((hF.hasFDerivAt.const_mul a).sub (hG.hasFDerivAt.const_mul b)).fderiv
  have hsumB : (∑ j, ∂ₜ (fun s => ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s · (j, i)) x) t)
      = ∑ j, ∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i) - ∂[i] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j)) x :=
    (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv
        (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff _ (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) (j, i)) t x).trans
      (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => congrFun (congrArg (∂[j]) (funext fun y =>
          time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix A (hA.of_le ENat.LEInfty.out) t y j i)) x)
  have hdiv : (∑ j, ∂[j] (∂[i] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j)) x)
      = ∂[i] (∇ ⬝ A.electricField 𝓕.c t) x := by
    show (∑ j, ∂[j] (∂[i] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j)) x)
        = ∂[i] (fun y => ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) y) x
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ =>
        congrFun (Space.deriv_commute (u := j) (v := i) _ (hEs j)) x]
    conv_rhs => rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis,
        fderiv_fun_sum (x := x) fun j _ => (hEd j j).differentiableAt]
    simp only [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis, FunLike.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply]
  have hg2 : ∂[i] (∇ ⬝ A.electricField 𝓕.c t) x = 𝓕.ε₀⁻¹ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x :=
    congrFun ((congrArg (∂[i]) hg).trans
      (Space.deriv_const_smul 𝓕.ε₀⁻¹ (LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space
        (hJ.differentiable (by decide)) t))) x
  have hs : (∑ j, ∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i) - ∂[i] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j)) x)
      = ∑ j, ∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x - 𝓕.ε₀⁻¹ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x := by
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ =>
        congrFun (Space.deriv_sub (u := j) _ _ (hEd i j) (hEd j i)) x]
    simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    rw [hdiv, hg2]
  rw [hA1, lin _ _ ((Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hBt j).differentiableAt)
    hJt.differentiableAt, Time.deriv_fun_sum _ _ fun j _ => (hBt j).differentiableAt]
  rw [hsumB, hs, hc, hc2, mul_sub, div_eq_mul_inv]

name: fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus'
proof:
lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  funext x₀
  by_contra hx₀
  let w := fun x => ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ
  have h0 : 0 < w x₀ :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne' real_inner_self_nonneg' (inner_self_eq_zero'.not.mpr hx₀)
  have hc : Continuous w := by fun_prop
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ0, hδ⟩ :=
    Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp (hc.continuousAt.eventually (isOpen_Ioi.mem_nhds h0))
  let φ : ContDiffBump x₀ := ⟨_, _, half_pos hδ0, half_lt_self hδ0⟩
  have key := hg _ (IsTestFunction.smul_right ⟨φ.contDiff, φ.hasCompactSupport⟩ (contDiff_const (c := f x₀)))
  simp only [inner_smul_right'] at key
  exact ne_of_gt ((φ.continuous.mul hc).integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero
      φ.hasCompactSupport.mul_right (fun x => if h : φ x = 0 then (mul_eq_zero_of_left h _).symm.le
        else mul_nonneg φ.nonneg (hδ x (φ.support_eq ▸ h)).le)
      (mul_pos (φ.pos_of_mem_ball (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ0)) h0).ne') key

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.progress
proof:
lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have der' := der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var | abs | tabs | sub => grind
  case inl d _ ih => exact (ih rfl d).imp .inl fun ⟨_, h⟩ => ⟨_, .inl h⟩
  case inr d _ ih => exact (ih rfl d).imp .inr fun ⟨_, h⟩ => ⟨_, .inr h⟩
  case app l r il ir =>
    right
    rcases il rfl l with v|⟨_,h⟩
    · rcases ir rfl r with w|⟨_,k⟩
      · rcases l.canonical_form_abs v with ⟨_,_,rfl⟩; exact ⟨_, .abs v.lc w⟩
      · exact ⟨_, .appᵣ v k⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .appₗ r.wf.2.1 h⟩
  case tapp d s ih =>
    right
    rcases ih rfl d with v|⟨_,h⟩
    · rcases d.canonical_form_tabs v with ⟨_,_,rfl⟩; exact ⟨_, .tabs v.lc s.wf.2.1.lc⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .tapp s.wf.2.1.lc h⟩
  case let' d _ ih _ =>
    right
    have b := (body_let.mp der'.wf.2.1).2
    rcases ih rfl d with v|⟨_,h⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .let_body v b⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .let_bind h b⟩
  case case d _ _ ih _ _ =>
    right
    have ⟨_, b₂, b₃⟩ := body_case.mp der'.wf.2.1
    rcases ih rfl d with v|⟨_,h⟩
    · rcases d.canonical_form_sum v with ⟨_,rfl|rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨_, .case_inl (by cases v; assumption) b₂ b₃⟩
      · exact ⟨_, .case_inr (by cases v; assumption) b₂ b₃⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .case h b₂ b₃⟩

name: Cslib.CCS.bisimilarity_congr_choice
proof:
theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  refine ⟨_, ChoiceBisim.choice h, fun _ _ k μ => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · intro z hz
    cases k with
    | choice hb => cases hz with
      | choiceL hp => exact (hb.follow_fst hp).imp fun _ w => ⟨Tr.choiceL w.1, .bisim w.2⟩
      | choiceR hp => exact ⟨z, Tr.choiceR hp, .bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl z)⟩
    | bisim hb => exact (hb.follow_fst hz).imp fun _ w => ⟨w.1, .bisim w.2⟩
  · intro z hz
    cases k with
    | choice hb => cases hz with
      | choiceL hp => exact (hb.follow_snd hp).imp fun _ w => ⟨Tr.choiceL w.1, .bisim w.2⟩
      | choiceR hp => exact ⟨z, Tr.choiceR hp, .bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl z)⟩
    | bisim hb => exact (hb.follow_snd hz).imp fun _ w => ⟨w.1, .bisim w.2⟩

name: Cslib.SKI.parallelReduction_diamond
proof:
theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a b c f
  induction f generalizing c
  all_goals intro g
  case refl => exact ⟨_, g, .refl _⟩
  case par x y z w fx fz ihx ihy =>
    cases g
    case refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .par fx fz⟩
    case par p q gp gq =>
      obtain ⟨u, hu, hu'⟩ := ihx gp
      obtain ⟨v, hv, hv'⟩ := ihy gq
      exact ⟨u ⬝ v, .par hu hv, .par hu' hv'⟩
    case red_I =>
      rw [I_irreducible (h := fx)]
      exact ⟨w, .red_I w, fz⟩
    case red_K =>
      obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible (h := fx)
      exact ⟨u, .red_K u w, hu⟩
    case red_S =>
      obtain ⟨u, v, hu, hv, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible (h := fx)
      exact ⟨u ⬝ w ⬝ (v ⬝ w), .red_S u v w, .par (.par hu fz) (.par hv fz)⟩
  case red_I =>
    cases g
    case refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_I ..⟩
    case par p q hp hq =>
      rw [I_irreducible (h := hp)]
      exact ⟨q, hq, .red_I q⟩
    case red_I => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
  case red_K =>
    cases g
    case refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_K ..⟩
    case par p q hp hq =>
      obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible (h := hp)
      exact ⟨u, hu, .red_K u q⟩
    case red_K => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
  case red_S =>
    cases g
    case refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_S ..⟩
    case par p q hp hq =>
      obtain ⟨u, v, hu, hv, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible (h := hp)
      exact ⟨u ⬝ q ⬝ (v ⬝ q), .par (.par hu hq) (.par hv hq), .red_S u v q⟩
    case red_S => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩

name: Core.InitsUpdatesComm
proof:
theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intro Hup Hinit
  have hl := UpdateStatesLength Hup
  have hl' := InitStatesLength Hinit
  exact ⟨_, rfl, updatedStatesInit hl' (UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined Hinit) Hup) (InitStatesNodup Hinit),
    ((UpdateStatesUpdated Hup ▸ InitStatesUpdated Hinit).trans ((updatedStatesComm (by
      rw [List.unzip_zip hl', List.unzip_zip hl]
      intro k a b
      have h := UpdateStatesDefined Hup k b
      simp_all [InitStatesNotDefined Hinit k a])).symm)) ▸ updatedStatesUpdate hl (updatedStatesDefMonotone (UpdateStatesDefined' Hup))⟩

name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time
proof:
lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  have hl (x y : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) :
      ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF x * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * ofCrAnListF y) =
      ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF x * ofCrAnListF y)) := by
    simp only [map_mul]
    let l₀ := List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
      (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (x ++ y))
    let l₁ := List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) x
    let l₂ := List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) y
    let l₃ := List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)
      (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (x ++ y))
    have h₀ : ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF x * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * ofCrAnListF y) =
        crAnTimeOrderSign (x ++ φ :: ψ :: y) • ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (x ++ φ :: ψ :: y))) -
        crAnTimeOrderSign (x ++ ψ :: φ :: y) • 𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) •
          ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (x ++ ψ :: φ :: y))) := by
      conv_lhs =>
        rw [← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
          superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF]
        simp [mul_sub, sub_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append]
        rw [timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
      simp only [map_smul, sub_right_inj]
      module
    have h₁ : ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (x ++ φ :: ψ :: y))) = ι (ofCrAnListF l₀) *
        ι (ofCrAnListF l₁) * ι (ofCrAnListF [φ, ψ]) * ι (ofCrAnListF l₂) * ι (ofCrAnListF l₃) := by
      rw [show x ++ φ :: ψ :: y = x ++ [φ, ψ] ++ y by simp, crAnTimeOrderList,
        insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ x [φ, ψ] y (by simp [hφψ, hψφ]),
        ofCrAnListF_append, ofCrAnListF_append, ofCrAnListF_append, ofCrAnListF_append, map_mul,
        map_mul, map_mul, map_mul]
    have h₂ : ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (x ++ ψ :: φ :: y))) = ι (ofCrAnListF l₀) *
        ι (ofCrAnListF l₁) * ι (ofCrAnListF [ψ, φ]) * ι (ofCrAnListF l₂) * ι (ofCrAnListF l₃) := by
      rw [show x ++ ψ :: φ :: y = x ++ [ψ, φ] ++ y by simp, crAnTimeOrderList,
        insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ x [ψ, φ] y (by simp [hφψ, hψφ]),
        ofCrAnListF_append, ofCrAnListF_append, ofCrAnListF_append, ofCrAnListF_append, map_mul,
        map_mul, map_mul, map_mul]
    have h₃ : ι (ofCrAnListF [φ, ψ]) - 𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) •
        ι (ofCrAnListF [ψ, φ]) = ι [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF := by
      rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton]
      simp only [← ofCrAnListF_append, List.cons_append, List.nil_append, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc,
        map_sub, map_smul]
    have h₄ : ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF x * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * ofCrAnListF y) =
        crAnTimeOrderSign (x ++ φ :: ψ :: y) • (ι (ofCrAnListF l₀) * ι (ofCrAnListF l₁) *
          ι [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * ι (ofCrAnListF l₂) * ι (ofCrAnListF l₃)) := by
      rw [h₀, h₁, h₂, ← h₃, crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ x y]
      simp only [smul_sub, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, mul_sub, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, sub_mul]
    have h₅ : ι (ofCrAnListF l₀) * ι (ofCrAnListF l₁) * ι (ofCrAnListF l₂) * ι (ofCrAnListF l₃) =
        ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (x ++ y))) := by
      rw [← map_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append, ← map_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append, ← map_mul,
        ← ofCrAnListF_append]
      simp only [l₀, l₁, l₂, l₃, crAnTimeOrderList]
      rw [← insertionSort_of_takeWhile_filter 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ x y]
    have h₆ : ι (ofCrAnListF l₀) * ι (ofCrAnListF l₁) * ι [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF *
        ι (ofCrAnListF l₂) * ι (ofCrAnListF l₃) =
        ι [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (x ++ y))) := by
      rw [← h₅, Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ)]
      simp only [mul_assoc]
    rw [h₄, h₆]
    by_cases hq : 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ = 𝓕.crAnStatistics φ
    · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat 𝓕.crAnStatistics 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel hφψ hψφ hq, ← crAnTimeOrderSign,
        ← map_mul, ← map_smul, ← Algebra.mul_smul_comm, ← timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, map_mul,
        ofCrAnListF_append]
    · simp only [ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic (Ne.symm hq), zero_mul, smul_zero]
  refine Submodule.span_induction₂ (p := fun x y _ _ =>
      ι 𝓣ᶠ(x * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * y) = ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(x * y)))
      ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
      (show a ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range ofCrAnListFBasis) from Basis.mem_span _ a)
      (show b ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range ofCrAnListFBasis) from Basis.mem_span _ b)
  · rintro x y ⟨φs, rfl⟩ ⟨φs', rfl⟩
    simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList]
    exact hl φs φs'
  · intro y hy
    simp only [map_mul, zero_mul, map_zero, mul_zero]
  · intro x hx
    simp only [map_mul, zero_mul, map_zero, mul_zero]
  · rintro x y z hx hy hz hpx hpy
    simp only [add_mul, mul_add, map_add, map_mul, hpx, hpy]
  · rintro x y z hx hy hz hpx hpz
    simp only [mul_add, map_add, map_mul, hpx, hpz]
  · rintro c x y hx hy hpx
    simp only [smul_mul_assoc, map_mul, map_smul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, hpx]
  · rintro c x y hx hy hpx
    simp only [mul_smul, map_mul, map_smul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, hpx]
